New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-orchestration-wallet-payments-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-orchestration-wallet-payments-2026.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-orchestration-wallet-payments.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/orchestration/wallet-payments`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/orchestration/wallet-payments, November documents private-preview Orchestration routing for Apple Pay and Google Pay across eligible processors. Enable the applicable wallet on the third-party processor under its own requirements and configure Stripe using the relevant Apple Pay or Google Pay integration. Use Dashboard Payments > Orchestration > Rules for test routing and optionally Payment Links for a quick routing test (new raw lines 23-38). For an attempted charge on a saved mobile-wallet payment method, pass off_session=true when confirming the PaymentIntent. A customer present in checkout must be re-prompted through Apple Pay or Google Pay and cannot reuse the saved method. Those distinctions and steps are in old raw lines 6-21. The sole mapped summary, source-stripe-orchestration-wallet-payments.md, retains routing, the two checkout cases and Payment Links testing (lines 13–19), but omits processor and Stripe configuration, the Dashboard test rule step and the November preview request context (new raw lines 7-21).
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/orchestration/wallet-payments, November adds a private-preview notice and email request with the orchestration_preview registration example (new raw lines 7-21; old raw lines 4-21). The May overview already records private-preview status (raw/stripe-orchestration-2026.md lines 8–10). The anchor only navigates to the request, and the remaining diff changes spacing and list presentation. Preserve the dated May setup, saved-wallet PaymentIntent confirmation and customer-present re-prompt guidance. Keep source-stripe-orchestration-wallet-payments.md, the concept and the feature matrix aligned on general Apple Pay and Google Pay support across Adyen, Braintree and Worldpay WPG, with 3DS unsupported for either wallet’s DPAN and Google Pay FPAN unsupported on Adyen (November feature-support raw lines 35–53). off_session=true belongs to PaymentIntent confirmation of a saved-wallet charge attempt, while the on-session presentment belongs to the wallet integration. The preview example is an access request. It supplies no account entitlement, payment API version or wallet configuration. Sandbox rules and Payment Links testing supply no evidence of live rule activation (November Rules raw lines 63–75) or payment, capture or settlement outcomes.
